en.intro: Sanjaya finishes by telling the king that he does not merely report the Gita, but lives inside it. Listen to how he describes his own response.
en.notice: Sanjaya calls the conversation between Krishna and Arjuna wonderful and holy, and he says he rejoices again and again every time he remembers it.
en.next: He remembers the form of Krishna and feels wonder and joy again and again.
en.meaning: O King, remembering again and again this wondrous, holy dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.

hi.meaning: हे राजन्, भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण और अर्जुन के इस पवित्र और अद्भुत संवाद को बार-बार याद करके मैं बार-बार हर्षित हो रहा हूँ।
hi.notice: संजय इस बातचीत को अद्भुत और पवित्र कहते हैं। वे कहते हैं कि इसे याद करने पर उन्हें बार-बार आनंद आता है।
hi.next: वे कृष्ण के उस अद्भुत रूप को बार-बार याद करते हैं और महान आश्चर्य और आनंद अनुभव करते हैं।

en.intro: Sanjaya finishes by telling the king that he does not merely report the Gita, but lives inside it. Listen to how he describes his own response.
en.body: O King, remembering again and again this wondrous, holy dialogue between Krishna and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again. Sanjaya calls the conversation between Krishna and Arjuna wonderful and holy, and he says he rejoices again and again every time he remembers it. He remembers the form of Krishna and feels wonder and joy again and again.
